test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 25 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: P and Q working alone can complete a work in 9 days and 18 days respectively. They work on alternate days one at a time. P works on the first day. In how many days the whole work will be completed?
solution:
**Given:**

P alone = 9 days

Q alone = 18 days

**Formula Used:**

Work = LCM of days

Efficiency = Work ÷ Days

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 9 and 18 = 18

⇒ Total work = 18

⇒ P's work per day = 18 ÷ 9 = 2

⇒ Q's work per day = 18 ÷ 18 = 1

⇒ Work in 2 days (P + Q) = 2 + 1 = 3

⇒ Work in 12 days = 3 × 6 = 18

**∴ The correct answer is 12.**
